# 2.5D Pet Actions Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add 2.5D paper-character visuals and richer pet actions while keeping uploaded images as the pet body.

**Architecture:** Extend settings with `visualMode` and `motionIntensity`, then let the renderer map interaction events to named action classes. The packaged runtime is the standalone renderer generated by `scripts/build-standalone-renderer.cjs`; React files stay type-safe and reasonably aligned, but the standalone renderer owns user-visible behavior.

**Tech Stack:** Electron, TypeScript, plain browser DOM/CSS animations, Vitest.

---

## File Structure

- Modify `src/shared/types.ts`: define `PetVisualMode` and `PetMotionIntensity` and add both fields to `AppSettings`.
- Modify `src/shared/validation.ts`: default and validate the new settings.
- Modify `src/shared/validation.test.ts`: cover valid and invalid visual settings.
- Modify `src/main/settings-store.test.ts`: update expected persisted settings through `DEFAULT_SETTINGS`.
- Modify `scripts/build-standalone-renderer.cjs`: add 2.5D CSS, action state management, sleepy timer, carried state, settings controls, and defaults.
- Modify `src/renderer/pet/PetWindow.tsx` and `src/renderer/pet/PetWindow.css`: keep React renderer compatible with new visual settings.
- Modify `src/renderer/settings/SettingsWindow.tsx`: expose basic controls for the new settings so `tsc --noEmit` stays clean and the development renderer remains coherent.
- Run `.\run.cmd typecheck`, Vitest, `.\run.cmd build`, and package verification.

- [ ] **Step 3: Add shared types and defaults**

Update `src/shared/types.ts`:

```ts
export type PetVisualMode = "classic" | "paper3d";
export type PetMotionIntensity = "soft" | "lively";

export interface AppSettings {
  activeAvatarId: string | null;
  petSize: number;
  alwaysOnTop: boolean;
  animationsEnabled: boolean;
  bubblesEnabled: boolean;
  audioEffects: Partial<Record<AudioEffectKind, AudioEffect>>;
  visualMode: PetVisualMode;
  motionIntensity: PetMotionIntensity;
}
```

Update `src/shared/validation.ts`:

```ts
const VISUAL_MODES = new Set(["classic", "paper3d"]);
const MOTION_INTENSITIES = new Set(["soft", "lively"]);

export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: AppSettings = {
  activeAvatarId: null,
  petSize: 180,
  alwaysOnTop: true,
  animationsEnabled: true,
  bubblesEnabled: true,
  audioEffects: {},
  visualMode: "paper3d",
  motionIntensity: "lively",
};

function normalizeVisualMode(value: unknown): AppSettings["visualMode"] {
  return typeof value === "string" && VISUAL_MODES.has(value) ? (value as AppSettings["visualMode"]) : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.visualMode;
}

function normalizeMotionIntensity(value: unknown): AppSettings["motionIntensity"] {
  return typeof value === "string" && MOTION_INTENSITIES.has(value) ? (value as AppSettings["motionIntensity"]) : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.motionIntensity;
}
```

Then merge these fields inside `mergeSettings`:

```ts
visualMode: normalizeVisualMode(input.visualMode),
motionIntensity: normalizeMotionIntensity(input.motionIntensity),
```

## Task 2: Standalone Renderer 2.5D Pet Actions

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/build-standalone-renderer.cjs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add renderer defaults**

In `scripts/build-standalone-renderer.cjs`, add to `DEFAULT_SETTINGS` in the generated JS:

```js
visualMode: "paper3d",
motionIntensity: "lively",
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Add action constants and state**

Add generated JS constants/state:

```js
const ACTION_DURATION_MS = {
  poke: 780,
  happy: 920,
  reward: 1100,
  annoyed: 1200,
  angry: 1450,
  carried: 0,
};
const SLEEPY_AFTER_MS = 18000;
let actionName = "idle";
let actionToken = 0;
let actionTimer = null;
let sleepyTimer = null;
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Add action helpers**

Add generated JS helpers:

```js
function isPaper3d() {
  return state.settings.visualMode !== "classic";
}

function setPetAction(nextAction, duration) {
  actionName = nextAction;
  actionToken += 1;
  const token = actionToken;
  if (actionTimer) clearTimeout(actionTimer);
  render();
  if (duration > 0) {
    actionTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      if (token === actionToken) setPetAction("idle", 0);
    }, duration);
  }
}

function resetSleepyTimer() {
  if (sleepyTimer) clearTimeout(sleepyTimer);
  sleepyTimer = setTimeout(function () {
    if (!moving && actionName === "idle") setPetAction("sleepy", 0);
  }, SLEEPY_AFTER_MS);
}

function wakePet() {
  if (actionName === "sleepy") setPetAction("idle", 0);
  resetSleepyTimer();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Replace flat pet markup with classic/paper3d markup**

In `renderPet`, render a stage with these important classes:

```js
const visualMode = isPaper3d() ? "paper3d" : "classic";
const intensity = settings.motionIntensity === "soft" ? "soft" : "lively";
const actionClass = "pet-action--" + actionName;
```

Paper3D mode markup should include:

```html
<span class="pet-shadow"></span>
<span class="pet-sparkles"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>
<span class="pet-sleep-marks"><i>z</i><i>Z</i></span>
<span class="pet-paper">
  <span class="pet-depth"></span>
  <img class="pet-avatar" ... />
</span>
```

Classic mode should keep a direct `<img class="pet-avatar">` inside the button.

- [ ] **Step 5: Wire interactions to actions**

Update handlers:

```js
function handlePoke(pet) {
  wakePet();
  // keep existing poke counter and audio behavior
  if (pokeCount <= 2) setPetAction("poke", ACTION_DURATION_MS.poke);
  else if (pokeCount <= 5) setPetAction("annoyed", ACTION_DURATION_MS.annoyed);
  else setPetAction("angry", ACTION_DURATION_MS.angry);
}

function handleReward(pet) {
  wakePet();
  // keep existing reward behavior
  setPetAction("reward", ACTION_DURATION_MS.reward);
}

function beginMove(event) {
  wakePet();
  setPetAction("carried", 0);
  // keep existing move behavior
}
```

On move end, call `setPetAction("idle", 0)` and `resetSleepyTimer()`.

- [ ] **Step 6: Add 2.5D CSS**

Add CSS classes:

```css
.pet-button--paper3d { perspective: 760px; transform-style: preserve-3d; }
.pet-paper { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform-style: preserve-3d; }
.pet-depth { position: absolute; inset: 8% 7% 7%; border-radius: 44% 56% 48% 52%; background: rgba(58, 83, 118, 0.28); transform: translateZ(-20px) translateX(10px) rotateY(55deg); filter: blur(0.4px); }
.pet-shadow { position: absolute; bottom: 8px; width: 62%; height: 18%; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); filter: blur(4px); transform: translateZ(-60px) rotateX(70deg); }
.pet-action--idle .pet-paper { animation: pet-paper-idle var(--idle-speed) ease-in-out infinite; }
.pet-action--poke .pet-paper { animation: pet-paper-poke var(--action-speed) cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.35, 0.36, 1); }
.pet-action--reward .pet-paper { animation: pet-paper-reward var(--action-speed) ease-in-out; }
.pet-action--annoyed .pet-paper { animation: pet-paper-annoyed var(--action-speed) ease-in-out; }
.pet-action--angry .pet-paper { animation: pet-paper-angry var(--action-speed) ease-in-out; }
.pet-action--sleepy .pet-paper { animation: pet-paper-sleepy 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pet-action--carried .pet-paper { animation: pet-paper-carried 900ms ease-in-out infinite; }
```

Define matching `@keyframes` for idle, poke, reward, annoyed, angry, sleepy, and carried.

In generated settings HTML, add controls:

```html
<label class="toggle-row"><span>2.5D paper effect</span><input id="visualMode" type="checkbox" checked></label>
<div class="segmented-control" role="group" aria-label="Motion intensity">
  <button class="segment-option" data-intensity="soft">Soft</button>
```

Wire them:

```js
document.getElementById("visualMode").onchange = function (event) {
  window.desktopPet.updateSettings({ visualMode: event.target.checked ? "paper3d" : "classic" });
};
root.querySelectorAll(".segment-option").forEach(function (button) {
  button.onclick = function () {
    window.desktopPet.updateSettings({ motionIntensity: button.dataset.intensity });
  };
});
```
